title: Filter notes by tag and export CSV
body:
Extend the notes HTTP service without changing its default JSON responses.

- R1: GET /notes?tag=VALUE returns notes with an exactly matching tag, ignoring case and preserving creation order.
- R2: GET /notes?format=csv returns text/csv with columns id,title,tags. Join multiple tags in one field with semicolons; quote CSV fields correctly and preserve Unicode.
- R3: CSV with no matching notes still contains the header and no data rows.
- R4: tag and format=csv work together in one GET /notes request.
- R5: GET /notes without query options still returns the original JSON list and POST /notes still creates notes.
